prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE original battle-ready enemy sprite illustration for industrial fantasy action RPG, M25 Recharge-Case Soldier from an abandoned underground hangar. An upright TALL RECTANGULAR BATTERY CASE on two small quick mechanical legs, with a broad thin circular shield DISC on one side carried by a compact clamp arm. Battery case IS its body, no human torso or head, no armored knight anatomy. The tall case has an exposed recessed capacitor core, ceramic terminals at its top, and a visible charging connector dock on its back edge; a small amber sensor inset into the upper rectangle. The flat round shield has six physical wedge-like segments with very small cyan charge indicators, some unlit to show finite shield capacity, no numbers or words. Stance turned slightly sideways ready to retreat and recharge, shield front and charging socket visible together. Coal-black steel, selectively worn ochre case, oxidized copper wiring, ivory ceramic batteries, restrained pale cyan shield nodes and warm core. Subtle mineral fibers at joints unify original mining utility-machine ecology. Premium richly hand-painted stylized industrial-fantasy, clean strong rectangle-versus-circle shape design, sculptural painterly lighting, believable material details without all-over noisy rust. Elevated three-quarter camera looking down 40 degrees, whole body, disc and feet fully framed within generous transparent safety margin. Readable at 70 pixels. Solid subject near fully opaque on genuine transparent alpha. No charging station or other prop, floor, shadow, background, pedestal, shield bubble, halo, text, logo, UI, watermark or existing game character.

alpha_validation.notes: Original generated alpha preserved; broad subject is nearly opaque. Boundary has only trace low-alpha generation noise, not opaque clipping.

visual_inspection: Tall battery-case rectangle contrasts with a flat six-segment round shield.
Some shield indicators unlit, indicating finite capacity.
Side charging connector and exposed core support the recharge mechanic.
production_status: Single battle-ready illustration. Full directional animation, attacks, recovery and 70-pixel in-engine visual QA remain separate deliverables.
